releases.body:
### Changed

- **Breaking:** the TUI runtime dependencies move from OpenTUI 0.8 to 0.9. `@opentui/core` and
  `@opentui/solid` are pinned at 0.9.9. `solid-js` stays at 1.9.18, inside the `^1.9.12` that
  `@opentui/solid` 0.9.9 peers. Installs that pin `@opentui/*` themselves, or that run the plugin
  beside another that expects OpenTUI 0.8, must move with it to keep a single Solid runtime. The
  supported host ranges and the minimum Bun (1.3.14) are unchanged.
- The real-host matrix adds OpenCode 1.19.6 and 2.4.2, the latest V1 and V2 releases. 1.19.6 is
  the first verified host on the 1.19 line.
- The real-host matrix in CI now runs the minimum and the latest release of each line, plus V2
  2.2.5 for OpenTUI 0.8. V1 1.18.30 through 1.18.32 and 1.18.35 leave the matrix. V2 2.0.26, 2.1.2
  and 2.2.0 move to the on-demand window (`tests/compatibility/verify-v2-window.ts`). The verified
  references are now 1.19.6 and 2.4.2. The supported ranges are unchanged.
- Bumped the runtime dependency `@opencode/client` and the dev dependency `@opencode/plugin` to
  2.4.2, with `bun.lock` synchronized.
- The OpenRouter decision model list adds `baseten/bison-1`, `baseten/groundhog-1`, `liquid/d1.2`,
  `liquid/d1.2-ultra` and `microsoft/microsoft-decision-1.1`, and drops `liquid/d1`. The new
  models are unbenchmarked, so selecting one raises a config notice
  ([Reviewer models](docs/REVIEWER-MODELS.md#openrouter)).

### Security

- Consumer installs no longer carry `glob` 9.3.5 and `minimatch` 8.0.7, which had the moderate
  GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 and GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249. They came in through `@opentui/solid`'s
  `babel-plugin-module-resolver`, which `@opentui/solid` dropped in 0.9.8. `npm audit` over a
  consumer install of the tarball reports no advisory. The root `overrides` stay for the dev
  dependency `@opencode/plugin`
  ([Supply chain](docs/SUPPLY-CHAIN.md#known-residual-exposure),
  [#128](https://github.com/noppu-labs/opencode-permission-reviewer/issues/128)).
- The audit no longer ignores GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf (`picomatch`), which GitHub withdrew
  ([#154](https://github.com/noppu-labs/opencode-permission-reviewer/issues/154)).

### Changed

- Answers to agent ask dialogs reach the reviewer with a full UTC timestamp
  (`[2026-09-01T12:01:03Z]`) instead of the time of day only, so answers given on different days of
  a long session no longer look alike.

### Fixed

- The V1 entrypoint refuses to load on a host that reports an OpenCode V2 version, and logs why
  even without `debug`. Its reviewer isolation is a single-file plugin, which V2 does not load, so
  every review used to fail closed with no visible cause. The message points at the V2 `"plugins"`
  key.

### Security

- Tools that usually only read are no longer labeled read-only when the command writes a file or
  runs a program. Before, a policy rule on workspace writes or code execution did not match these
  forms, and the reviewer was told the command only read.
  - `sort` reads `-o` inside a short-option cluster (`sort -uo FILE`, `-nruoFILE`) and as an
    abbreviated long option (`--out=FILE`). `--compress-program` counts as code execution.
  - `uniq` and `xxd` report their second operand as a write.
  - `tree` reports `-o FILE`, including after an attached level (`-L2 -o FILE`), and `-R`, which
    writes a listing into each directory it visits.
  - `yq` reports `-i` inside a flag cluster (`-iP`) or with a value (`--inplace=true`), and
    `-s`/`--split-exp`, which writes a file per result. With `--security-allow-write-any-path`,
    the write can land outside the workspace.

### Changed

- The OpenRouter decision model list adds `google/gemini-decision-1`, `heygen/heygen-decision-1`,
  `heygen/heygen-decision-1-turbo`, `nace-ai/drex-max-finance`,
  `perplexity/pplx-decider-flash-v1.3:free` and `perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.3:free`. They are
  unbenchmarked, so selecting one raises a config notice
  ([Reviewer models](docs/REVIEWER-MODELS.md#openrouter)).
- The list names `parallel/decisions-fast` instead of `parallel/decisions-fast:free`, following
  OpenRouter's listing. A config that names either is still read as a System One model.
- Bumped the runtime dependency `@opencode/client` to 2.3.2 and the dev dependencies
  `@opencode/plugin` to 2.3.2 and `@opencode-ai/plugin` and `@opencode-ai/sdk` to 1.19.6, with
  `bun.lock` synchronized.
- Bumped the dev dependencies `@biomejs/biome` to 2.6.7, `knip` to 6.45.1, `string-width` to 9.0.0
  and `tsdown` to 0.23.7.

### Security

- A `$'…'` word with an escape that bash, bash 3.2 and zsh decode differently could hide a command
  from the emergency brake or make it look read-only. zsh reads `$'r\m'` as `rm`, `$'\-delete'` as
  `-delete` and `$'\C-\x4a'` as a newline, bash 3.2 keeps `\u0027` as written where later shells
  read a quote, and bash ends `<<$'E\[F'` at `E\[F` where zsh ends it at `E[F`. The analysis read
  them all as bash 4.4 and later do. The brake now also reads such words the way zsh and bash 3.2
  do. A heredoc delimiter with such an escape, or with a NUL, is treated as never terminating,
  including inside a substitution or a command string. The capability report warns about such a
  command and lowers its class confidence; a `read-only` class becomes `unknown`, and any other
  class is kept, so policy rules that match it still apply.
- GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf (`picomatch` through 4.0.7, high) is ignored by ID in the audit. No patched
  `picomatch` release exists yet. It reaches this repository only through the dev dependencies
  `knip`, `tsdown` and `@opencode/plugin`, and this package neither ships it nor imports from it.
  Issue #154 tracks removing the ignore.

### Changed

- `homepage` in `package.json` is the plugin's page on toolkit.noppu.com instead of the GitHub
  repository, so npm and jsDelivr link to it. The README links to that page and to noppu.com.
- Bumped the runtime dependency `@opencode/client` to 2.2.7 and the dev dependency
  `@opencode/plugin` to 2.2.7, with `bun.lock` synchronized.
- Bumped the dev dependencies `@biomejs/biome` to 2.6.5 and `tsdown` to 0.23.5.

### Changed

- The OpenRouter decision model list adds `cloudflare/clairic`, `morph/reflex` and
  `parallel/decisions-fast:free`. They are unbenchmarked, so selecting one raises a config notice
  ([Reviewer models](docs/REVIEWER-MODELS.md#openrouter)).
- The list drops `inception/mercury-decide`, which OpenRouter no longer serves. A config that
  names `openrouter/inception/mercury-decide` is no longer treated as a System One model.
- Bumped the runtime dependencies `@opencode/client` to 2.2.6 and `semver` to 7.8.6, and the dev
  dependency `@opencode/plugin` to 2.2.6, with `bun.lock` synchronized.
- Bumped the dev dependencies `@biomejs/biome` to 2.6.4, `knip` to 6.44.1 and `tsdown` to 0.23.4,
  and the CodeQL actions to 4.39.3.

### Security

- GHSA-chp3-j5qr-2vfr (`effect` before 4.0.0-beta.103, moderate) is documented as residual
  exposure and ignored by ID in the audit. `@opencode-ai/plugin` pins `effect` 4.0.0-beta.83
  exactly and has no release with the fix; the V1 host supplies that runtime, and this package
  neither ships it nor imports from it ([Supply chain](docs/SUPPLY-CHAIN.md#the-effect-runtime)).
